front: What congenital defect is commonly associated with a cleft anterior mitral leaflet?
back: Primum ASD (partial AVSD). Endocardial cushion defects generally involve the mitral valve to varying degrees. Isolated cleft AMVL is rare.
All mitral chordae insert into a SINGLE papillary muscle. Results in subvalvular mitral stenosis. Component of Shone complex.

front: List the four obstructions of Shone complex.
back: 1) Supravalvular mitral ring. 2) Parachute mitral valve (subvalvular MS). 3) Subaortic stenosis (membrane). 4) Coarctation of the aorta.

front: Cor triatriatum sinistrum — key distinguishing Doppler finding vs valvular MS?
back: Cor triatriatum produces a pressure gradient across the LA membrane BOTH in systole and diastole. Valvular MS produces a diastolic gradient only.

front: What is a supravalvular mitral ring?
back: A congenital fibrous ring in the LA above the mitral annulus that obstructs LV inflow. Component of Shone complex; mimics mitral stenosis.
Mitral chordae insert on BOTH sides of the interventricular septum (rather than only the LV). Seen in complex AV canal defects and complex CHD.
